metrics.workdir_dsl:
workspace "Claims Center" "C4 model of the insurance claims platform" {

    model {

        claimsCenter = softwareSystem "Claims Center" "The insurance company's claims platform for reporting and tracking claims, owned and operated by the insurance company" {

            webPortal = container "Web portal" "Where policyholders report claims and track their progress" "HTML/JavaScript"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile app backend" "Serves the insurer's mobile app" "REST API"
            claimsIntake = container "Claims intake service" "Registers new claims" "REST API"
            triage = container "Triage service" "Classifies and prioritizes claims" "REST API"
            assessment = container "Assessment service" "Calculates settlement amounts" "REST API"
            payout = container "Payout service" "Executes claim settlements" "REST API"
            fraudScreening = container "Fraud screening service" "Flags suspicious claims" "REST API"
            documentService = container "Document service" "Accepts claim photos and reports" "REST API"
            notification = container "Notification service" "Emails and messages policyholders" "REST API"
            assignment = container "Assignment service" "Routes claims to adjusters" "REST API"
            adjusterWorkbench = container "Adjuster workbench" "Where staff process their assigned claims" "HTML/JavaScript"
            policyVerification = container "Policy verification service" "Checks that a claim is covered by the policy" "REST API"
            reinsuranceAllocation = container "Reinsurance allocation service" "Apportions large losses across reinsurance partners" "REST API"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch scheduler" "Runs the nightly reserves calculation" "scheduled job"
            eventQueue = container "Event queue" "Carries claim events between the application parts" "message queue"
            claimsDatabase = container "Claims database" "Stores claim records" "SQL database"
            policyDatabase = container "Policy database" "Stores policy and cover records" "SQL database"
            auditDatabase = container "Audit database" "Stores the compliance audit trail" "SQL database"
            documentStore = container "Document store" "Holds claim photos, reports, and correspondence" "object store"
        }

        policyholder = person "Policyholder" "Reports claims and tracks their progress"
        adjuster = person "Adjuster" "Staff member who processes assigned claims"

        claimsDataBureau = softwareSystem "National claims data bureau" "Operated by a different organization"
        clearingHouse = softwareSystem "Clearing house" "Operated by a different organization"

        policyholder -> webPortal "reports claims and tracks their progress" "HTTPS"
        policyholder -> mobileAppBackend "reports claims and tracks their progress via the mobile app" "HTTPS"
        adjuster -> adjusterWorkbench "processes assigned claims" "HTTPS"

        webPortal -> claimsIntake "uses" "REST"
        webPortal -> assessment "uses" "REST"
        webPortal -> payout "uses" "REST"
        webPortal -> documentService "uses" "REST"
        webPortal -> notification "uses" "REST"

        mobileAppBackend -> claimsIntake "uses" "REST"
        mobileAppBackend -> assessment "uses" "REST"
        mobileAppBackend -> payout "uses" "REST"
        mobileAppBackend -> documentService "uses" "REST"
        mobileAppBackend -> notification "uses" "REST"

        claimsIntake -> triage "hands accepted claims to" "REST"
        triage -> assessment "routes claims to" "REST"
        assessment -> payout "requests settlements from" "REST"

        claimsIntake -> fraudScreening "sends each incoming claim for screening" "REST"
        claimsIntake -> policyVerification "requests cover checks for each incoming claim" "REST"
        assignment -> adjusterWorkbench "routes claims to" "REST"

        fraudScreening -> claimsDataBureau "consults" "REST"
        payout -> clearingHouse "executes settlements through" "REST"

        documentService -> documentStore "reads from" "object store API"
        batchScheduler -> claimsDatabase "reads and writes" "SQL"
        batchScheduler -> policyDatabase "reads and writes" "SQL"
        notification -> policyholder "reports claim status changes" "email/SMS"

        claimsIntake -> eventQueue "publishes new claim events" "events"
        payout -> reinsuranceAllocation "apportions large losses" "REST"
        payout -> auditDatabase "records settlement audit trail" "SQL"
    }

    views {
        systemContext claimsCenter "SystemContext" "System context diagram of the Claims Center" {
            include *
            autoLayout
        }
        container claimsCenter "Containers" "Container diagram of the Claims Center" {
            include *
            autoLayout
        }
    }

    configuration {
        scope "SoftwareSystem"
    }
}

workspace "Bank Portal" "C4 model of the online banking platform" {

    model {

        customer = person "Bank Customer" "A customer of the bank who manages accounts, moves money, and tracks activity."

        bankPortal = softwareSystem "Bank Portal" "The online banking platform, owned and operated by our company." {

            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Where customers log in and manage their accounts." "Web Application"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the bank's mobile app." "API"
            accountService = container "Account Service" "Holds the customer account records." "Service"
            transactionService = container "Transaction Service" "Processes deposits, withdrawals, and transfers." "Service"
            paymentService = container "Payment Service" "Executes card payments and bank transfers." "Service"
            cardService = container "Card Service" "Manages debit and credit cards." "Service"
            fraudDetectionService = container "Fraud Detection Service" "Scores transactions for fraud." "Service"
            notificationService = container "Notification Service" "Sends email and SMS alerts." "Service"
            onboardingService = container "Onboarding Service" "Verifies new customers." "Service"
            statementsService = container "Statements Service" "Generates monthly statements." "Service"
            directDebitService = container "Direct Debit Service" "Processes standing orders and direct debits." "Service"
            exchangeRatesService = container "Exchange Rates Service" "Provides currency conversion rates." "Service"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly interest calculation and reconciliation." "Batch"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries internal events between the application parts." "Queue"
            ledgerDatabase = container "Ledger Database" "Stores every account movement." "Database"
            customerDatabase = container "Customer Database" "Stores account and profile records." "Database"
            auditDatabase = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail." "Database"
            cache = container "Cache" "Stores sessions and frequently read account data." "In-memory Data Store"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds the generated statement PDFs." "File Store"
        }

        cardPaymentNetwork = softwareSystem "Card Payment Network" "A card payment network operated by a different organization."
        creditReferenceAgency = softwareSystem "Credit Reference Agency" "A credit reference agency operated by a different organization."

        customer -> bankPortal "manages accounts, moves money, and tracks activity"
        bankPortal -> cardPaymentNetwork "routes card authorisations"
        bankPortal -> creditReferenceAgency "performs credit checks"

        customer -> webPortal "manages accounts, moves money, and tracks activity" "Web browser"
        customer -> mobileAppBackend "manages accounts, moves money, and tracks activity" "Mobile app"

        webPortal -> accountService "uses"
        webPortal -> transactionService "uses"
        webPortal -> paymentService "uses"
        webPortal -> cardService "uses"
        webPortal -> statementsService "uses"
        webPortal -> directDebitService "uses"

        mobileAppBackend -> accountService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> transactionService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> paymentService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> cardService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> statementsService "uses"
        mobileAppBackend -> directDebitService "uses"

        transactionService -> ledgerDatabase "updates the ledger"
        transactionService -> fraudDetectionService "scores transactions"
        transactionService -> eventQueue "publishes events"

        notificationService -> eventQueue "consumes events"
        statementsService -> ledgerDatabase "reads the ledger"
        statementsService -> documentStore "writes statement PDFs"
        batchScheduler -> ledgerDatabase "reads and writes"
        batchScheduler -> customerDatabase "reads and writes"

        paymentService -> cardService "uses"
        paymentService -> exchangeRatesService "uses"
        onboardingService -> customerDatabase "reads customer records"

        paymentService -> cardPaymentNetwork "routes card authorisations"
        onboardingService -> creditReferenceAgency "performs credit checks"
    }

    views {
        systemContext bankPortal "SystemContext" "System context diagram of the Bank Portal." {
            include *
            autoLayout
        }

        container bankPortal "Containers" "Container diagram of the Bank Portal." {
            include *
            autoLayout
        }
    }
}

metrics.workdir_dsl:
workspace "Claims Center" "C4 model of the insurance claims platform" {

    model {

        policyholder = person "Policyholder" "Reports claims and tracks their progress"

        mobileApp = softwareSystem "Mobile App" "The insurer's mobile app"

        claimsCenter = softwareSystem "Claims Center" "The insurance company's claims platform" {
            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Policyholders report claims and track their progress"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the insurer's mobile app"
            claimsIntake = container "Claims Intake Service" "Registers new claims"
            triage = container "Triage Service" "Classifies and prioritizes claims"
            assessment = container "Assessment Service" "Calculates settlement amounts"
            payout = container "Payout Service" "Executes claim settlements"
            fraudScreening = container "Fraud Screening Service" "Screens each incoming claim and flags suspicious claims"
            documentService = container "Document Service" "Accepts claim photos and reports"
            notificationService = container "Notification Service" "Emails and messages policyholders"
            assignmentService = container "Assignment Service" "Routes claims to adjusters"
            adjusterWorkbench = container "Adjuster Workbench" "Staff process their assigned claims"
            policyVerification = container "Policy Verification Service" "Checks that a claim is covered by the policy"
            reinsuranceAllocation = container "Reinsurance Allocation Service" "Apportions large losses across reinsurance partners"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly reserves calculation"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries claim events between the application parts"
            claimsDatabase = container "Claims Database" "Stores claim records"
            policyDatabase = container "Policy Database" "Stores policy and cover records"
            auditDatabase = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds claim photos, reports, and correspondence"
        }

        dataBureau = softwareSystem "National Claims Data Bureau" "A national claims data bureau operated by a different organization"
        clearingHouse = softwareSystem "Clearing House" "A clearing house operated by a different organization"

        policyholder -> webPortal "reports claims and tracks progress"
        policyholder -> mobileApp "reports claims and tracks progress"
        mobileApp -> mobileAppBackend "sends requests to"

        webPortal -> claimsIntake "submits new claims to"
        webPortal -> assessment "requests settlement amounts from"
        webPortal -> payout "requests settlements from"
        webPortal -> documentService "sends claim photos and reports to"
        webPortal -> notificationService "requests status updates from"

        mobileAppBackend -> claimsIntake "submits new claims to"
        mobileAppBackend -> assessment "requests settlement amounts from"
        mobileAppBackend -> payout "requests settlements from"
        mobileAppBackend -> documentService "sends claim photos and reports to"
        mobileAppBackend -> notificationService "requests status updates from"

        claimsIntake -> triage "hands accepted claims to"
        triage -> assessment "routes claims to"
        assessment -> payout "requests settlements from"

        assignmentService -> adjusterWorkbench "routes the claim to"

        fraudScreening -> dataBureau "consults"
        payout -> clearingHouse "executes settlements through"

        documentService -> documentStore "reads from"
        batchScheduler -> claimsDatabase "reads and writes"
        batchScheduler -> policyDatabase "reads and writes"
        notificationService -> policyholder "reports claim status changes to"
    }

    views {
        systemContext claimsCenter "SystemContext" "The system context view of the Claims Center" {
            include *
            autoLayout
        }

        container claimsCenter "Containers" "The container view of the Claims Center" {
            include *
            autoLayout
        }
    }
}
